vertical_datum_caveat: NONNA negative elevations interpreted as local-chart-datum bed; source-survey datum ambiguity remains. bed_igld85_estimated uses linearly interpolated Kingston/Brockville chart datum offsets (74.20/73.95m), not an authoritative datum separation surface.
interpolation: Raw bed_chart_m is NaN at unknown wet cells; nearest_depth_chart_m supplied separately, along with distance. No gaps silently filled.

native_bed_aggregation.method: Arithmetic mean of finite native-resolution source bathymetry samples inside each grid cell; no depth invented. NONNA100 fallback where no fine sample is finite.
